doc: Accessory / mechanism library. Every accessory is an occupancy envelope (3D collision object), NOT a label or image. Hardware spec cannot be treated as decoration.
source: Kessebohmer storage-solution library (LeMans, Magic Corner, DISPENSA, CONERO)
envelope_model: Accessory { min_width, max_width, min_depth, required_height, front_clearance, side_clearance, mounting_points, collisions }
compat_engine: Cabinet + accessory request -> NOT COMPATIBLE | compatible options (Accessory compatibility engine, Level 38)

items.name: LeMans corner swing-out shelf
items.note: organically shaped shelves; specific cabinet-space + installation requirements; separate mounting instructions

items.so: ideal for corner kitchens with HINGED doors

dressing_room_program.note: wardrobe lifts, pull-outs, belts/ties, clothes rails, shoe storage -> accessories library objects

accessory_compatibility_engine.note: Accessories must respect cabinet dims + opening type (door vs drawer). Tell the designer what IS possible, not merely allow incorrect geometry (Level 38).
